title: Saint Alder's Rising
author: Coral Yarrow
blurb: Jude Lockridge, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
